rejected.reason: Not eligible as delivered. The OGA page (https://opengameart.org/node/107722) lists CC-BY 3.0, but the bundled 'LICENSE - RPG Orchestral Essentials.pdf' is a custom End-User License Agreement dated 2nd May 2019 by Jonathan Shaw. It grants royalty-free use provided attribution is given, and it terminates on breach. That is not CC-BY text and is not on the brief's allowed list. The EULA's canonical URL https://www.jshaw.co.uk/RPG-Orchestral-Essentials-eula returns HTTP 404 (Wix error page), so the licence cannot be re-checked online. Reject unless the lead accepts the custom EULA. If accepted, the attribution line is: "The Precipice of Victory" Composed by Jonathan Shaw (www.jshaw.co.uk). Zip header PK (valid), 2,855,442 bytes, matches the page's 2.9 MB.
